editorial: When a sudden tragedy strips away all safety, you are thrown into a desperate, visceral fight for survival. This action-thriller genre piece is immediately gripping, capturing the chaotic, raw desperation of a mother fighting a system designed to fail her. The film excels in the brutal choreography, making every desperate street fight feel earned and exhausting. While the second act occasionally drags with excessive exposition, the film’s unrelenting emotional core keeps you anchored to Nikki’s impossible quest. You will feel the palpable tension as she moves from suburban life into the deepest reaches of the criminal underworld.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of contained, intense action thrillers who appreciate grounded, physical conflict.
